findings.rationale: Store bootstrap goes through the hippo CLI only: new P1.4 input `hippo init --id --visibility`, run by the operator (A3.3 step 1, A3.7 commit 1); no script or shell writes repo.toml.

scripts/hippo-git-hook.sh fails closed when hippo is missing and .hippo/ paths are staged or merged; post-merge writes an unchecked-merge marker that blocks commits until hippo check runs (A3.4 step 9).

A3.1 files-mode matrix covers every subcommand incl. reply/close/supersede/handoff close and handoff --decision/--lesson files; A3.5 handoff and learn text routes both states through project-record.js.

A3.2 rule A broadened (lowercase backlog forms for W4/W12), rule C required-writer list for W20/W21, W1/W9 templates moved into project-record.js; check-plan-graduation check mode + negative control in A3.4.

repo.toml created by `hippo init` run by the operator (no model redirection); Q3 reconciled: .hippo/ dev-repo-only, mirror exclusion wired in A3.7 via repo-layout.js, and the cutover waits for the dev/release split.

New hippo-problems state surfaces check exit 3 offending files (detect + session-start); guard refuses Bash .hippo paths when hippo is absent; pre-commit/pre-merge-commit exit non-zero for .hippo paths without hippo.
backlog new gains --context/--context-file and global --target/--key; write-time validation via the shared lib/backlog-rules.js runs in both modes before any write.
A3.3, A3.4 and A3.6 run on the shared sandbox harness (sandbox HOME, temp HIPPO_CONFIG_DIR, temp repos); KR1 cells and their test included.
Files-mode matrix per subcommand with golden-file cases; superseded added to the §3.2 mapping (hippo status set is kind-independent) with a parity fixture.
§3.3 step contract: root key k and child keys k.n, per-step skip by key/edge/status lookups, refusal reports created ids and resumes via --key; fault points after each step type, each red-checked.
Plugin-dir case uses a temp copy; lib/hippo.js takes HIPPO_BIN else PATH; harness sets git identity and HIPPO_ACTOR, asserts detect=hippo, and traps checkout changes.
Folded: fail-closed hooks and guard without hippo, backlog_frozen keyed on repo.toml presence, exit 3 surfaced, guard engages only in store repos; negative controls with hippo hidden.
Folded: bootstrap is an operator-run `hippo init` (no mkdir/printf); depth-0 never runs it in the real checkout; the rehearsal uses the same command.

Folded: report mode in validate.sh until A3.7 --enforce; seeded allowlist + re-pin; project-record.js lines are not findings; handoff unit joins the cutover and backlog_frozen covers ADR/handoff files; only the lesson unit may stay held via pending.
Folded: cutover includes the plugin version bump, .claude/record-store.json min_plugin_version warning in session-start, and refile instructions in the frozen notice.
Folded: without a courier no holder is written; a fixed 'not observed' line plus git-read branch/commit; progress only as labelled narrative.
Folded: project-record.js prints and returns full 26-char ULIDs; skill text passes them to fleet --hippo and resume lines; tested in A3.1.
Folded: every phase splits mechanism and wiring/guidance commits; A3.7 lists its commits (store, githooks, frozen notices, guidance per unit, version).
Folded: temp HIPPO_CONFIG_DIR seeded with a leak-guard copy, KR1 cells under a plugin-free sandbox HOME with an operator-placed 0600 credential, env header enforced by the route checker.
Folded: check-backlog-entries --reconcile (backlog_unimported) runs at the cutover pre-merge-commit/post-merge with a negative control; repair is a provenance-keyed import of missing ids only.
